entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I placed about a month and a half ago. I need to return a pair of road cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit and preference issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I can't get them dialed in. Honestly, they're just giving me terrible blisters after every ride, and at this point, I'd just prefer a refund.
I'm sorry to hear the cycling shoes aren't working out for you. Blisters are definitely no fun and can ruin a good ride. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I've got it here. It looks like you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you for a full refund. I'll just need your order number to get started.

Oh, that's great news. The order number is VF7781-9. I really appreciate you making that easy. Since I have to box them up and ship them back, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future purchase for the inconvenience?

That's a reasonable question. While I'm not authorized to issue a discount on top of a full product refund, I can assure you the return process is straightforward and free. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You'll get 100% of your money back as soon as we receive the item.
Okay, a full refund is the most important thing. I can accept that. The email just came through. So I just print this and drop it at the post office?

That's correct. Just pack the cycling shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you're all set. Once our warehouse scans it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that covers it. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
